winner_reason: B applies the actual Another Lens method and labels its assumptions and illustrative numbers, while A swaps in its own lenses and states unsourced statistics as fact.

A covers all four requested dimensions with depth and without inventing facts about the user's product. B follows the method's lenses and gives a measurable spec, but fabricates prototype details and thins out sensory and isolation.
A runs the three-lens method and converts it into specific, testable design changes with stated assumptions; B is a strong essay outside the method.

B applies the named Anti-Heroes method with paired counter-moves, necessary-friction check and ledger while still giving usable facilitation language; A's script is polished but substitutes an invented persona for the method.

B maps the named anti-hero patterns to the exact screens with paired counter-moves and keeps inputs and assumptions separate, while A relies on a looser framework and confident unsourced legal claims.
A applies the Anti-Hero cards and flips each to a Hero with guardrails and honest limits; B uses invented personas and thinner flips.
B completes all twelve Bad Design Canvas cells with severity, redesigns, statement, verdict and ledger; A offers a custom harm taxonomy that skips the canvas.
A applies all twelve canvas categories with severity, classification, redesign and verdict, and flags what the brief leaves unknown; B ignores the canvas and assumes app behavior.
B applies the Bad Design Canvas properly (12 cells, severity, statement, verdict) and separates assumption from fact, while A is a generic, repetitive harm list without the method.
A gives eight traceable, testable anti-goals with load-bearing selection and an explicit invented-scenario note; B offers three broader goals without tests.
A gives the specific, failable anti-goals the user asked for, with tests; B supplies long episode-style narratives the user said to skip.
B ties episodes to testable anti-goals, prioritises the load-bearing ones and flags its assumptions; A's pitches drift from the product and its anti-goals are not grounded in them.
A actually runs CIDER (assumptions, imagined person, design, second cycle) and flags invented personas, while B is a generic review with unmarked statistics.
A applies CIDER as published and labels its assumptions; B is a broader but generic audit that invents the method acronym and the current design.

B applies CIDER's actual stages (assumptions, exclusion scenarios, redesign, register, second cycle, commitment) with an assumption ledger, whereas A invents the acronym's meaning and presumes the system's flaws.
A applies the Critical Interviewing structure and safeguards power asymmetries far more concretely than B's generic protocol.
B applies the interviewing method closely with sequencing, probes, harms and guardrails and stays honest about unknowns, while A is a generic script that presumes findings.
B uses the method's own question structures and covert categories and adds participant safeguards and sequencing; A relies on leading, direct challenges.
A applies DAH Cards structure with sorting, consequence mapping and a ticket-ready change and logs its assumptions; B fabricates a session and uses a generic prompt deck.
B applies the actual card-pair and sorting method with explicit assumptions and ticket-ready output; A substitutes a generic principle checklist.
B invents the user's session results and business practices as fact; A states assumptions openly and still delivers a usable manifesto and vision.
A applies the Digital Ethics Compass faithfully and flags unknowns; B invents a session, participants, decisions and targets and ignores the method structure.
A applies the actual Compass categories with specific, owner-assigned outputs and an evidence ledger; B uses an unrelated framework.
A applies the Digital Ethics Compass faithfully with a transparent evidence ledger; B substitutes its own structure and asserts unsupported specifics.
B gives measurable triggers, named owners, veto red lines, specific harms and an evidence ledger, while A stays at generic commitments.
A converts the duty of care into owned, measurable, enforceable commitments with a risk register and tension map; B is a sound but more generic contract.
B turns principles into gated, owned, measurable commitments and is explicit that anonymization is unverified, while A stays generic.
A states its limits and marks inferences, while B invents specific incidents and quotes about the user's company and discloses this only in a closing ledger.
A applies the method with an evidence ledger and marks assumptions, while B fabricates numerous specifics and states commitments and internal culture as fact.
B applies the Ethicography structure exactly and marks unknowns, while A is a generic post-mortem that asserts unsupplied organizational facts.
B maps dark patterns to named fair patterns, includes harm analysis for specific populations, a prioritized plan and a ledger. A is a solid but generic redesign with unmarked claims.
A delivers a method-shaped, prioritised and measurable audit; B is a readable but generic pattern-by-pattern list, though A has some invented causes.
A applies the full Fair Patterns audit with legal mapping, harm analysis, owned and measurable fixes and an honest evidence ledger; B covers a single pattern and gives a loose redesign.
A follows the Humane Design Guide's worksheet, alternatives and stack analysis and is more specific, while B is a generic critique that asserts unstated product details.
A applies the actual guide structure with named mechanisms, affected populations and tiered alternatives; B is a generic checklist audit with an invented lens set.
B actually executes the Humane Design Guide steps with differential-harm analysis, tiered alternatives and an evidence ledger; A is a good generic audit.
A applies the method stepwise with worst-case inversion, convergence, forecast, redesigns and an evidence ledger; B is a generic critique with its own method definition.
B actually executes the Inverted Behavior Model stages, converts findings into redesigns with metrics, and flags unknowns. A is a generic harm list that misses the method.
B applies the published method end to end, including the convergence check against the actual design, and flags unspecified elements honestly; A is a looser generic inversion table.
A executes the Motivation Matrix as designed with context columns and flagged cells and states its assumptions; B is a looser feature-by-motivation essay.
B actually applies the Motivation Matrix and gives cell-linked redesigns, though its invented features cost it on honesty; A is safer but is a generic audit.
A applies the matrix across motivation types and user contexts, ties redesigns to risky cells, and documents assumptions; B is a mechanic-by-mechanic commentary without ledger.
A applies the three-lens scheme with a conflict matrix, flags unknowns, and surfaces the paternalism and business-model tensions. B follows a different pipeline and states unknowns as facts.
B applies the full scheme, offers testable actions, and is honest about unknowns, whereas A asserts research and effects without basis and applies the method only partially.
A applies the full Normative Design Scheme with maps, matrices and commitment and labels its evidence; B is a looser essay missing method components.
A applies Pledge Works faithfully with falsifiable pledges, owners, consequences and an assumptions ledger; B is a generic charter with unverified references.
A applies the method more faithfully with owners, thresholds, consequences, traceability and an honest evidence ledger; B is a competent but generic pledge list.
A applies the method with owners, consequences and stress testing and keeps assumptions labelled. B invents audit data and does not follow the method's structure.
B applies the Prism's scored axes and mechanism audit concisely with an evidence ledger, while A substitutes an invented eight-lens framework and presents assumptions as facts.
A applies the prism's actual axes, mechanism naming and reflection prompts with deeper analysis of vulnerable groups; B maps elements cleanly but substitutes its own framework.
A applies the Prism's axes, mechanisms and reflection stages with an honest evidence ledger, while B uses its own lenses and asserts many unsupported product facts.
A applies each Stanford tool as published, marks unknowns and illustrative content, and evaluates both options in depth; B invents statistics and replaces key tools with generic scorecards.

B applies the toolkit's Weighing Options structure faithfully, gives actionable gates and next steps, and tracks evidence honestly. A is a generic comparison with no obstacles, organizational view or action plan.
A applies the Ethics Frame and Ethics Gauge as published and stays honest about unknowns, while B substitutes a risk matrix and fabricates survey statistics.
A applies the method as designed with rated dams, unblock conditions and safeguards plus an evidence ledger, while B reduces it to a stakeholder pros-and-cons table.
A applies Value Dams and Flows as specified and marks what is known; B has richer design detail but not the method's analysis or an evidence record.

B applies the method's mechanics (dam strength, power to unblock, conditions to dissolve), reaches an actionable decision with ethical floors, and logs assumptions. A is a competent but generic pairwise mapping.
B applies the method fully with an actionable plan and flags assumptions, whereas A invents specific statistics and only loosely applies the method.
A applies the actual levers with owners, resistance counters and an honest evidence ledger; B drifts from the method and invents sources and results.
B applies the real Values Levers with a concrete plan and ledger; A swaps in its own lever set and scripts invented research quotes.
B completes the full Worrystorming sequence including clustering and reframing worries into design values, and documents its assumptions; A stops at a worry list.
B carries worries through to constraints, tests and mitigations with honest unknowns; A is a vivid but unactionable list with an invented session setting.
B applies the worrystorming method through objectives, constraints and test questions, is more concise, and marks assumptions; A is longer, pseudo-quantified and less faithful.
